title: A Bridge for the Uniform
author: Edmund Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Almeida, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
